Name: Hades Cooking Boons
Author: undare
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#cc4125]Hades [/color][color=#ff7700]Cooking [/color][color=#f1c232]Boons[/color][/b]
[/size]
[b]Update 1.0.1
Added Chinese (Thanks kiwipart!) and Spanish Translations
The cooking boons are no longer needed for the collection completion.
-Reduced some effects, and buffed gold value a bit on all the boons.


[/b][b][color=#93c47d][size=5]About[/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=4]"Hades 1.0"[/size][/color][size=3] just launched!  Been playing more than 100 hours on the early access! (Such a good game![/size][color=#d5a6bd] <3[/color][size=3] )[/size][/b]
[b]Now you can go to you "Kitchen" (After upgrading your house)[/b]
[b]And cook some powerful[color=#ffd966] god boons[/color] with some sugar and mundane items like a [color=#c27ba0]grape [/color]or a [color=#ead1dc]peach[/color].[/b]
[b]
[/b][b]This contains [color=#ffd966]8 items[/color]. With very vague item descriptions, who will give you some nice buff for 4 (In real life) minutes.[/b]
[b]While they double as decorative items to show on tables/endtables![/b]
[b]
[/b][b]The mod is spoiler free ;) [/b]

[b]
[/b][b][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]Install[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3][b]Unpack inside your Stardewvalley/Mods folder.[/b]
[b]Install the requirementes above.[/b]
[b]
[/b][b][color=#f1c232]Note[/color] : While this mod requires [color=#f6b26b]Content Patcher Animations[/color], they can be turned off  (to [color=#dd7e6b]false[/color]).

[/b][/size][/center]

-Reduced Duration and strenght on some effects
-Dionisius Boon got a bit buffed
-Raised a bit the gold value of all boons
-These items are no longer required for the collection

-Chinese Translation (Thanks kiwipart !)
